mapper.select:
select a.id, a.code, a.name, a.enabled, count(e.id) as equipment_count, a.created_at from area a left join equipment e on e.area_id = a.id
and ( a.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and a.enabled = #{enabled}
group by a.id, a.code, a.name, a.enabled, a.created_at
order by a.created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into area ( code, name, description, enabled ) values ( #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled} )
mapper.select:
select id, code, name from area where enabled = 1
and ( code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by name
